gemini.title: Gm Sbi Polygon
gemini.abstract: Gm Sbi Polygon is an authoritative dataset published by Greater Manchester Ecology Unit. It represents gm sbi polygon features using multipolygon geometry.
gemini.lineage: Published by Greater Manchester Ecology Unit as open ecological data. Loaded into Systra PostGIS database without transformation.

columns.name: site_id
columns.description: Identifier assigned by the source dataset.

columns.name: site_name
columns.description: Name associated with the represented feature.

columns.name: cent_gr
columns.description: Ordnance Survey National Grid Reference for the centre of the site.

columns.name: site_gra
columns.description: Ecological site grade, such as A, B or C.

columns.name: district
columns.description: Greater Manchester district containing the ecological site.

columns.name: features
columns.description: Habitats, species or ecological features supporting the site's designation.

columns.name: date_est
columns.description: Date on which the ecological site record or designation was established.

columns.name: fid
columns.description: Feature identifier assigned by the source or import process.

columns.name: geom
columns.description: Spatial geometry of the represented feature.
